releases.displayName: 🎃 The Mound – Halloween Major Update: Cult of Tsathoggua

items.text: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45528915/ec868679f7ba76ad6a3ac9449c11ff6c8edfe01d.png"]Something stirs beneath the earth...
A mysterious prisoner, a forgotten cult, and a terrifying creature waiting in the darkness.
Our Halloween Major Update: Cult of Tsathoggua is here, bringing a brand-new quest to access a new underground map, deadly enemies, new weapons, cursed treasures, and a major progression overhaul!
Here's everything you can discover in this Major Update.

notes.title: 🐙 New Quest: The Shrine of Tsathoggua

items.text: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45528915/a6aba40c49720e6a0d0ce6c4308df2d46ba52e54.png"]
A prisoner chained in the depths of the Galleon has a story to tell. And he might just lead you somewhere you wish you'd never found...
Once you've unlocked the southern regions, head to the lower deck of the Galleon and speak to the prisoner.
He'll set you on a new quest to uncover the Shrine of Tsathoggua.
How does it work?
Find Eyes of Tsathoggua hidden inside shrines during Treasure Hunt missions.
You can find up to one Eye per expedition.
Collect 6 Eyes and bring them back to the Galleon to unlock a new location.
Be careful! Eyes lost during an expedition won't count toward your progress.
You can collect Eyes on any map and repeat expeditions as often as you like.
Eyes collected while playing as a guest also count toward your own progression.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45528915/3bb5fbceb5ac6d09e1f96bd2e01ee1458c041209.png"]
Deep beneath the earth, something ancient is waiting.
Explore a brand-new underground location and come face-to-face with Tsathoggua, a colossal creature immune to conventional weapons.
Your guns won't save you this time. You'll need to figure out another way to defeat it.
You'll find torches, salts, and healing supplies scattered throughout the lair to help you survive.
Defeat Tsathoggua to earn the Eye of Servitude, a powerful new occult relic.
All players who complete the mission will receive the reward, and only the host needs to have unlocked the map for everyone to join.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45528915/f8173c9392621686246b129ebfa2f02f00da97be.png"]
The darkness has a few new surprises waiting for you.
Tsathoggua: A colossal entity ruling over its underground lair.
Frog-Fishman: A new creature lurking in Tsathoggua's Lair and on selected maps near the Mound.
New Tentacles: Watch out for new tentacle threats during Portal Contracts.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45528915/0e0cf2613040eee802c7a9985f2184fb0c4e3f2e.png"]
A few new tools might help you survive your next expedition.
Swivel Breech Flintlock: An upgraded flintlock capable of firing two shots before reloading.
Hand Grenade: A new explosive weapon available directly from the shop.
Eye of Servitude: A new occult relic that lets you turn monsters against their own kind. Hold it up to an enemy and watch the chaos unfold!
Some treasures are better left untouched.
We've introduced Cursed Treasures, valuable-looking items that come with a dangerous twist.
You'll recognize them by a red flash in your inventory, a distinctive sound, and an on-screen warning.
Each cursed treasure carries a specific effect that targets whoever is holding it.
Screaming Idol: Makes noise while you carry it. Good luck staying unnoticed.
The Trees Will Listen: Nearby trees turn hostile and attack you with their branches.
Mi-Go's Beacon: Attracts a Mi-Go to your location. Keep holding it, and another might join the party.
Blood Price: Reduces your maximum HP by 50%.
Will you risk carrying one back to the Galleon?

notes.title: 📈 Progression Overhaul: Rank 70 & New Skill Tree

items.text: Your adventures can now take you even further!
We've increased the maximum rank to 70 and reworked the progression system with a brand-new skill tree.

notes.title: Here's how the new system works

items.text: Earn 1 skill point per rank.
Spend your points at the statue aboard the Galleon.
Choose one perk per row to customize your character.
Reset your skill tree at any time to recover all spent points.
Bonus inventory slots remain free and don't require skill points.
Important: Perks unlock immediately when selected, without a confirmation prompt.
[table equalcells="1" colwidth=","]
Perk
Effect
Carry Strength
Carry bodies without losing movement speed and pick up objects faster.
Stamina Bonus (2 tiers)
Increase stamina to 125%, then 150%.
Improved Night Vision
Gain a faint glow that reveals your immediate surroundings in darkness.
Bleed Resistance (2 tiers)
Reduce the duration of bleeding effects.
Red Dust Immunity
Become immune to worm parasites caused by breathing red dust.
Pious
Start each expedition with a crucifix.
Bomber-man
Start each expedition with a bomb.
First Kit
Start each expedition with salts.
Backstab Specialist
Enemies can no longer evade your backstabs.
Map-Savvy
Reveal potential item locations on your map.
Dread Damage Resistance
Reduce dread damage received from enemies.
Armor Specialist
Run silently while wearing armor.
Knife Specialist
Your knife never breaks.
Experiment with different perks to find the combination that best suits your playstyle!
Can you still trust what you see?
We've extended one of the most loved sanity effects to new items.
Your mind might be playing tricks on you in ways you haven't experienced before.
And the best part? Your teammates might see things very differently...
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45528915/5b03c0fd6cf41a9159232ae8b3441e4bbc60c2fb.png"]
Halloween has arrived aboard the Galleon!
Halloween Decorations: The Galleon has received a spooky seasonal makeover.
Cultist Outfits DLC: Four new cultist outfits, one for each main character, are now available as a paid DLC. Once purchased, you can equip them from the character selection screen.
Alongside all the new content, we've also made a few fixes and technical improvements.
Cursed Jar: Black Ichor now correctly enrages and attracts all monster types.
Swivel Breech Flintlock: Fixed a visual issue causing a gunpowder element to appear incorrectly during certain carrying animations.
Shader Optimizations: Improved shaders for better performance. Please note that shader compilation may take slightly longer on the first launch after updating on PC.
That's everything coming with Cult of Tsathoggua!

Whether you're hunting down Eyes of Tsathoggua, experimenting with the new skill tree, or discovering just how dangerous cursed treasures can be, we hope you enjoy everything this Major Update has to offer.
As always, thank you for your support and feedback. Keep sharing your adventures with us!
The Mound Team

items.text: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45528915/e4941e1a8aa716f0c2817bc765cf602b9b5b5383.png"]
Hello explorers,
We’ve been working on improving the overall experience in The Mound: Omen of Cthulhu, with a particular focus on performance and some issues affecting player inventories.
Optimizations
Improved memory performance.
Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue causing the mushroom from the Ghost inventory to disappear.

A big thank you to everyone who took the time to report the inventory issue. The videos, reproduction steps, and detailed reports shared by the community were extremely helpful in identifying and fixing the problem.
Your feedback continues to help us improve The Mound: Omen of Cthulhu, so please keep sending us your reports and let us know if you encounter any other issues.
Share your thoughts in the forums or on our Discord - we're listening.
The Mound: Omen of Cthulhu - out now on Steam, PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.
RedditTiktok Twitter Discord[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45528915/77e3c95843979a807ebf02c9373b69aa9ad54ac4.gif"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45528915/62d1d63e48cf4a1e7dfde8740b8bd56608c958f9.png"]Howdy explorers,
Have the new creatures lurking within the jungle been causing you trouble?

We're currently working on our next big patch, but we've also been trying to resolve some outstanding issues that have been cropping up for some players. One of these has been the performance of the in-game voice chat.

While it's been working as intended for some, we have had reports of voice chat sounding robotic or not working at all. We've overhauled it to resolve these issues and given it extensive testing. Since The Mound: Omen of Cthulhu uses spatial audio, and some sanity effects use voice, we recommend playing using the in-game voice chat.

If you continue to experience issues with the in-game voice chat, please let us know on our Discord or in the Steam Discussions. Outside of that, it's a relatively small patch, but read on for the full notes.
Fixed voice chat corruption during crossplay and on certain systems
Address profile setting issues with TSR and XeSS
Fixed the orb from the Mound level not handling damage properly
Share your thoughts in the forums or on our Discord - we're listening.
The Mound: Omen of Cthulhu - out now on Steam, PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.
RedditTiktok Twitter Discord[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45528915/77e3c95843979a807ebf02c9373b69aa9ad54ac4.gif"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45528915/fd592a1fdddfba55b8af1f7f3bdb45af5ef3bc6f.png"]
Hello explorers,

It's been a couple of weeks since our last update, which focused on quality-of-life improvements, with updates to our matchmaking, filters, the ability to teleport out if you get stuck, and other tweaks and changes.

Today's update is focused on bringing new content to The Mound and is part of our plans for the continued expansion and development of the game. We're able to do this thanks to the support you've shown for our game, and we hope you enjoy each update we'll continue to put out.

With this patch, there will be new creatures to avoid and a new reason to explore every nook and cranny of the map to build a new occult item. So get on out there or read on for the rest of the patch notes.
3 new enemies that appear in the depths of the forest. These horrors appear when you least expect them
New hidden jewel boxes scattered across the mainland. Find them all using the map to unlock a new Occult Item from the shop!
New Occult Item: The Rosary (see above)
Command Wheel 2.0: By popular demand we have added a new function to allow you to stop the cart and give it instructions. Proximity determines whether or not you use the horn.
New Lobby Codes: We now use automatically generated join codes instead of manual passwords to search for specific lobbies.
Optional Passwords: You can add an optional, encrypted password for private sessions.
More crash, bug and freezing fixes, including getting stuck in the Galleon's shops.
Miscellaneous bug fixes
Adjustments to the melee combat
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45528915/246bebbcfbfbf117a34a78740c0111a6c5f6f3fb.png"]
Hello explorers,

We're back with another patch for The Mound: Omen of Cthulhu. Our latest patch focuses on Quality of Life features to improve your overall game experience. We're starting with an improved matchmaking experience with filters to show you region, language, etc. and Quickmatch that will put you in game without visiting the server list.

We've also made some improvements to in-game voice chat, optimisation, and the ability to teleport yourself out if you find yourself stuck. You can also pet Carlito, which might be the most important addition this patch.
We've got a larger patch in the works with some wider content additions planned soon, so stay tuned for that, as there is much more to come for the Mound.
Updated voice chat, fixing audio corruption issues and improving audio spatialization.
New 'Quickmatch' option and matchmaking filters to find better multiplayer sessions.
Incorporated geometry streaming technology for better memory management and other optimisations for increased performance.
New 'teleport to safety' option for rare cases when players get stuck, preventing the loss of the entire mission.
Improved backstabbing mechanic: Players can now backstab enemies that have aggro to deal significant damage. (Enemies with no aggro are still executed)
Fixed spear and headshot achievements that were not unlocking under certain scenarios.
You can now pet 'Carlito' the Ox on the ship.
Added a minor stun to enemies when they are blocked, improving the blocking ability.
Players can reorganise their hotbar inventory with a gamepad.
Added a new sanity illusion.
Share your thoughts in the forums or on our Discord - we're listening.
The Mound: Omen of Cthulhu - out now on Steam, PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45528915/dd57d5bfc9288f3a974658106717f7ff8c33b182.jpg"]
Hello explorers,

It's been a couple of weeks since the launch of The Mound: Omen of Cthulhu. We hope you've been enjoying the special kind of chaos that can only be brought by cosmic entities beyond our understanding and if you think you've started to understand how things work, then we're going to have to do something about that.

Foreshadowing aside, we've had a lot of feedback about the tools players have at their disposal to deal with the Mound. This is a short patch, but with some big changes. The largest of which is the addition of a block ability, that will help you avoid getting overrun by the creatures coming for you.
We're aware that this could have a big effect on the balance and difficulty of the game. So we're going to be monitoring how it lands, so sound off in the comments section about how it feels in-game.
1.02 Patch Notes
Fix for players seeing low performance in Ultra Settings when re-launching the game
Fix for multiple enemies of the same class spawning in some missions
Progress recovery tool for all platforms based on achievement / trophies progress.
New block function (Q on Keyboard or RB/R1 on controller)
Fixed Saints not loading after missions (which was introduced in patch 1)
Fixed no knives appearing when playing the game in Single-Player
Reduced Saints blessing costs
Slight increase for tokens given for contract tiers
Rescuing a character in the mainland means a contract is successful regardless of whether or not the treasure was returned
Migo enemy captures players for less time in Single-Player
Fixed weapon appearance in ultrawide configurations
Captain now uses some dialogue lines which were previously not being used
Fix for torches losing flame
Improvements to local voice (some issues remain that we're looking into)
Console
Fix for losing progress on PS5

There's more to come for the Mound, and the dev team is hard at work. Making changes based on your feedback (hello block ability). So if you like what you see, join the expedition, and we'll see you on the island.

items.text: Hello expeditioners,
We're dropping our first hotfix for The Mound: Omen of Cthulhu onto Steam.

This patch is designed to address a lot of the issues that people have encountered since release. There are some improvements to optimisation & camera selection, bug fixes, balance, Crossplay (particularly finding lobbies with your friends) and more.

PLEASE NOTE: If you've been playing on the beta branch, you may need to restart your Steam client or revert back to the default beta branch. If you need a refresher on how to do that, you can find it here.
Improved performance profiles for PC
Added server setting to be able to find sessions using a password
Ability to organise items in your own inventory with a mouse during interactions with the wagon added
Modified the Saints shop so these are no longer bought at the woodshop. Saints are now equipped for a smaller cost at the ox wagon before an expedition
Added a pre-configuration screen on first launch letting players choose a cinematic camera or a standard camera (standard camera may help with feelings of delayed interaction or motion sickness)
Key bindings are now saved between sessions
"Censer mission" updated with several improvements. Purple corruption areas modified and are slower to kill players.
Crawling canopy enemy (spider) does 50% less damage.
Added a machete to starting gear of all missions so players are never stuck with only knives.
Adjustments to general enemy damage difficulty
Slightly buffed stamina and run speed when tired.
Knives do slightly more damage.
Pole weapons have a bit more range.
Enemies take longer to spawn when the forest wakes up.
Fixed replication for some death animations, which was causing T-posing.
Fixed replication of the "bleeding" state on clients who were not seeing the effect.
Fixed cases of players getting stuck on walls after climbing.
Fixed "Game Saving" icon not being displayed with some events.
Fixed motion blur setting slider.
Fixed Mi-Go enemy behavior which did not cause them to search for players, so they rarely showed up in game sessions.
Fixed a crash related to isolation fog.
Fixed many other minor bugs.
Added far LODs for many areas where pop-in was visible.
Optimisation improvements for console versions
We also have two known issues that will be resolved in a following patch:
Saints are disappearing after one expedition unless you restart a lobby
Issues where mics are not correctly being picked up in-game

This goes alongside other things that the team are looking into like combat feel and the tools you have to deal with the threats this cursed jungle sends your way. Stay tuned for more information on what's next!
Share your thoughts in the forums or on our Discord - we're listening.
The Mound: Omen of Cthulhu - out now on Steam, PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.

releases.displayName: Test next week's patch on a Beta Branch

items.text: Hello Expeditioners,
We hope your journeys towards the Mound have been full of adventure, treasure, and definitely not full of horrifying hallucinations and mind bending creatures.
Since launch, we've had a lot of feedback and the teams are already hard at work on a first patch that will resolve some of the things you've brought up.
Please note that if you want to try this Open Beta patch, the crossplay isn't enabled.
Optimisation (FPS & performance)
Inventory Management (coming next patch for keyboard & mouse. Controller support to follow in a later update)
Server Finder Password for playing with friends on different platforms

A preconfig screen letting you choose between the Cinematic or Default camera (this already exists in the settings for the players who may feel a lack of responsiveness or lag, if you want to try it out already).
Other Quality of Life Features and Bug Fixes
Some balancing and configuration tweaks
We'll have a full list of the changes prepped to go live alongside the patch, so stay tuned for more information.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45528915/7e579206121a59f524329e9997919523f9929625.png"]A look at the upcoming config page when starting the Mound: Omen of Cthulhu.

And if you're interested, you can check these updates right now on the Open Beta branch we've set up here on Steam. This will allow you to play the latest version of the patch as it stands right now. It's possible that this version may have some unintended bugs, so if you come across anything, please let us know in the Steam discussions or our developer Discord.

Just note, that while playing on the Open Beta branch you will not be able to play with console players or players who are not on the same branch. So if you're looking to play with friends, make sure that you're on the correct branch to be able to play with them. You can swap branches at any time.

notes.title: So, how to access the beta branch?

items.text: RESTART your Steam App
Go to your Steam game library
Right click on The Mound: Omen of Cthulhu and click Properties...
Select the tab Game Versions & Betas
In the first dropdown box select \[OPEN BETA]
Click close and wait for the update to finish downloading
Please review your graphic setting in game again after applying the patch.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45528915/9cdd0b6a97ff264ebfc268c39b4940f9de7133e4.png"]
We're planning to release this patch on all platforms early next week with some additional tweaks and changes that will be made ahead of release.
Thank you so much for supporting our team, checking out the Mound: Omen of Cthulhu and we hope your next trip into the Jungle won't be your last.
Share your thoughts in the forums or on our Discord - we're listening.
The Mound: Omen of Cthulhu - out on Steam, PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45528915/cbc811b0ea9f225426869d837e8ab2f8f3425ba5.png"]
Thank you for playing The Mound: Omen of Cthulhu. This first update since the demo brings new content, a significant wave of community-driven improvements, and a preview of what's coming next.
Weapon Upgrade Anvil - a new station on the main ship lets you spend tokens to improve or upgrade weapons given by contracts.
Hand-drawn art pieces now accompany logbook narrations on the rowboat map.
New guidebook page added at the combat dummy on the ship, covering combat mechanics.
New sanity effect. We're not telling you what it is.
Several of these came directly from your feedback: thank you for taking the time to share it.
Fixed camera smoothing when disabling all camera effects, for 1:1 mouse-to-camera movement
Push to talk added
The mandatory hard cap at the end of missions has been removed: players can now remain on the mainland as long as they can survive
Better diversity of treasure shrines and additional treasure pickups in missions
Language column added to the find games screen
Improved weapon balance for contracts
Accessibility option added: dot at the centre of the screen for motion sickness
FOV slider range expanded from 85–115 to 75–125
Multiple players can now interact with the ox-wagon inventory simultaneously
Single Player: New gestures to command your bot companion to switch between silent weapons and a rifle - more effective but noisier
Prologue ending cinematic extended with additional narration
Contracts now display more mission information and a greater variety of treasure requirements
You can now leave game sessions while spectating
Improved voice 3D spatialization
Improvements to doppelganger behaviour
Multiple sanity effect improvements
Various bug and crash fixes
Replication fixes for foliage and other in-game actions
Many visual and screen loading optimisations

After looking into it, Crossplay is working fine, but we have indeed identified an issue whereby you cannot invite your friends to play via Crossplay. We are currently working on a fix and will do our best to provide it as soon as possible, making crossplay invitations easier and more reliable.
In the meantime, the available workaround is to find your friends’ server in the online server list. We realise that this method is inconvenient and apologise again for any trouble caused.

We're also working on a block and counterattack system for certain weapons. We want to give players more tools in critical moments without removing the threat that close-range combat should feel like. We're taking our time to get that balance right... with many more fixes and improvements.
There's a lot more to come!
Share your thoughts in the forums or on our Discord - we're listening.
The Mound: Omen of Cthulhu - out now on Steam, PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45528915/e10b483257242f147a29a07084f8bd31dffe215f.png"]
A new build is live for the Steam Next Fest Demo. Here's what changed.
Weapon looting from corpses - you can now pick up weapons directly from enemy bodies. One less reason to go in empty-handed.
Two new sanity effects added to the rotation. We're not telling you what they are. You'll know.
Guidebook codex pages can now be discovered across the mainland - piece together more of what The Mound doesn't want you to know.
Firearm ammo drops now carry more bullets per pickup, and undead enemies have a slightly higher chance of dropping them.
Additional weapons and ammo placed in select areas.
Appraiser sentiment improved - gear brought back from missions is evaluated more favourably.
Subtitle font size option added to the settings menu.
Several interface visual improvements.
Improved Huemul behaviour.
Players can no longer go into token debt.
Fixed a stretching polygons bug in the onboarding area.
Players now crouch in first person when picking up bodies.
Fixed time warnings from the forest state not appearing.
The Map item no longer behaves like the Medallion item.
Multiple minor issues addressed.
Keep the reports coming - the demo is shaping the launch build, and every piece of feedback helps.
The Mound: Omen of Cthulhu launches July 15 on PS5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC.
